metadata.name: bordrless_launch
metadata.description: The Bordrless launchpad: creates a Bordrless Token Standard token with the rules it fixes at launch (installing the kit as its token hook when it has any) and its curve pool on the Bordrless DEX, runs the sniper fee, the creator fee, the holder fee and the burn as the pool's hook, graduates the pool with locked liquidity and pays creators.

docs: Instructions of the launchpad.

instructions.name: after_swap
docs: Pool hook: a buy's burn; a sell's creator and holder fees, from the output the DEX hands
on.

accounts.name: launch

`["launch", mint]` with that mint, so the owner, the discriminator and the mint bind it
without a derivation.

docs: writable holding of the quote before paying it).

accounts.name: kit_config
docs: rewards are on.

without a derivation.

docs: writable holding of the quote before paying it).

fixed once created, for launches to use by its key.

instructions.name: create_launch
docs: Creates a token and its curve pool, from the inline rules or from a `LaunchConfig`. With
a custom hook, the remaining accounts are the hook, the token program's signer for it,
its registry for the mint and the registry's extras.

share of the creator fee (1 to 5,000 basis points of it) on every launch someone else makes
from it, fixed for ever.

accounts.name: config

instructions.name: graduate

hook, the remaining accounts are the hook, the token program's signer for it and the
registry's extras.

accounts.name: reward_vault

types.name: Delta
docs: One cut an answer takes from the amount.

docs: How much (above zero).

fields.name: account
docs: Index in the callback's account list (prefix first, then extras) of the holding that
receives it. Must be an extra.

types.name: HookReturn
docs: What a callback may answer in its return data. Which fields a callback may fill depends on the
callback and the flags ([`Allowed`]); the calling program refuses an answer that fills any
other field.

fields.name: deltas
docs: Cuts from the amount (the transfer; a swap's input before, its output after), at most
[`MAX_DELTAS`].

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: `before_swap` only: the LP fee to apply instead of the pool's.

fields.name: source_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_burn`): the source holding's new hook data
([`HOOK_DATA_LEN`] bytes).

fields.name: destination_hook_data
docs: Token callbacks only (`before_transfer`, `before_mint`): the destination holding's new hook
data.

fields.name: quote_holding
docs: The launch's holding of the quote (creator fees).

fields.name: creator_fees_accrued

docs: Base added to the pool at graduation.

fields.name: graduation_burned

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, fixed at launch.

docs: The kit modules of `rules` (0: no kit, no token hook).

fields.name: kit_config
docs: `PDA(["kit", mint], KIT_ID)`, derived whatever the modules (the pool hook's fixed key).

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: `holding(quote_mint, kit_config)`, derived whatever the modules: the kit's reward vault
when holder rewards are on, where holder fees go.

fields.name: kit_caller_bump
docs: Bump of `PDA(["kit-caller", mint], LAUNCH_ID)`, which signs the kit's `init` and
`graduate`; 0 without a kit.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: creator_bought
docs: The creator's own first buy took the normal LP fee inside the sniper window (once).

fields.name: holder_fees_accrued
docs: Holder fees taken so far (bridged SOL, into the holder vault).

fields.name: burned_on_trades
docs: Tokens burned on trades (both sides; not the graduation burn).

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from; the default key for inline rules.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook (from the config), when the token has one. It runs on every
transfer, mint and burn its flags name; nobody vets its code.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The custom hook's flags; 0 without one.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: The config author's share of the creator fee (basis points of it), from a listed config
whose author is not the launch's creator; 0 otherwise. Fixed at launch: every claim pays
the author this part of what it takes.

fields.name: author_fees_paid
docs: Creator fees paid to the config's author so far (quote).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: LaunchConfig
docs: A launch config (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.7): the rules, the creator fee and, for a
build-your-own token, the creator's own token hook, made with the SDK by anyone as a keypair
account (so its key can be shared and pasted), fixed once created and usable for any number of
launches. `create_launch` takes one as an optional account; without one the rules come inline.
A config can never touch the protocol's share.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version.

fields.name: creator
docs: Who made it.

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules (within the launch config's bounds when made, checked again at launch).

fields.name: creator_fee_bps
docs: Creator fee on every swap, in basis points of the quote.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook program (§5.8), when the config is for a build-your-own
token; then no kit module may be on (one token hook per mint). The mint is created with it
and no hook authority.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: The hook's flags (`bordrless_hook::token_flags`); 0 without a custom hook.

fields.name: label
docs: A short name, for the site.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation time.

fields.name: author_share_bps
docs: A listed config's author share (`create_listed_config`): the part of the creator fee, in
basis points of it (at most `MAX_AUTHOR_SHARE_BPS`), paid to `creator` (the config's
author) on every launch made from it by someone else. Fixed at creation; 0 for a config
made with `create_config`.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved.

types.name: LaunchConfigCreated
docs: A `LaunchConfig` was made (by anyone, with the SDK).

fields.name: rules
docs: The token rules, fixed at launch.

fields.name: modules
docs: The kit modules they installed (0: no kit, no token hook).

fields.name: kit_config
docs: The token's `KitConfig` when it has a kit.

fields.name: holder_vault
docs: Where holder fees go (the kit's reward vault) when holder rewards are on.

fields.name: creator_unlock_at
docs: The creator wallet unlocks at this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_window_end
docs: Buys from the pool before this time are locked; 0 when off.

fields.name: early_unlock_at
docs: ... until this time; 0 when off.

fields.name: config
docs: The `LaunchConfig` the launch was made from, when it was.

fields.name: custom_hook
docs: The creator's own token hook, when the token has one.

fields.name: custom_hook_flags
docs: Its flags; 0 without one.

types.name: LaunchRules
docs: The rules a launch fixes for its token (`docs/hooks-v2.md` §5.1): what the pool hook takes on
each side, and the kit modules the token gets. Holder rewards are on when either holder fee is
above 0.

fields.name: holder_fee_buy_bps
docs: Holder fee on buys, from the quote input, paid to the holder vault.

fields.name: holder_fee_sell_bps
docs: Holder fee on sells, from the quote output after the protocol fee.

fields.name: burn_buy_bps
docs: Burn on buys, from the token output.

fields.name: burn_sell_bps
docs: Burn on sells, from the token input.

fields.name: max_wallet_bps
docs: Max wallet in basis points of the supply; 0 = off. Lifts at graduation.

fields.name: creator_lock_secs
docs: Creator wallet lock, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_window_secs
docs: Early-buyer window, counted from the launch; 0 = off.

fields.name: early_lock_secs
docs: Early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch; above `early_window_secs` (0 when the lock is
off).

types.name: Phase
docs: Before or after the operation.

types.name: PoolHookArgs
docs: Arguments of a pool hook callback.

fields.name: op
docs: The operation.

fields.name: phase

fields.name: pool
docs: The pool.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Base mint.

fields.name: quote_mint

fields.name: actor

fields.name: recipient

fields.name: amount_out

fields.name: base_reserve

fields.name: virtual_base

fields.name: virtual_quote

fields.name: swap_count

fields.name: created_at

fields.name: lp_amount

fields.name: hook_data

types.name: PoolOp

fields.name: max_holder_fee_bps

fields.name: max_burn_bps

fields.name: max_rules_fee_bps
docs: Largest creator fee + holder fee + burn on one side.

fields.name: min_max_wallet_bps
docs: Smallest max wallet (when on).

fields.name: max_max_wallet_bps
docs: Largest max wallet.

fields.name: max_creator_lock_secs

docs: Latest early-buyer unlock, counted from the launch.
